summary: Backend-only testing completed for Music League app. All 31 tests pass (100%). Focused testing on CRITICAL voting dropdown count and points system as requested. Key findings: voting dropdown correctly shows N-1 options where N is total submissions (e.g., 4 players = 3 dropdown options). Points system correctly implements N-1 scoring (1st=N-1 pts, 2nd=N-2 pts, etc.).
critical_code_review_comments: Voting dropdown count logic: Backend correctly enforces that each voter can only rank (N-1) songs where N is total submissions. Users cannot vote for their own song.
Points system verified: 1st place gets (N-1) points per voter, 2nd gets (N-2), 3rd gets (N-3), etc. Total points distributed = (number of voters) × (N-1 + N-2 + ... + 1)
Self-vote prevention: API correctly rejects votes containing user's own submission (400 error)
Non-submitter vote prevention: Only users who submitted can vote (403 error if not submitted)
3-player scenario: 3 submissions → 2 dropdown options (rank 1st and 2nd), points: 1st=2, 2nd=1
5-player scenario: 5 submissions → 4 dropdown options (rank 1st through 4th), points: 1st=4, 2nd=3, 3rd=2, 4th=1
All existing tests (auth, league, round, voting N-1 system, standings, chat, zero-point users) continue to pass
